decisions.summary: A root the program computes (r = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), 3 writes in 1 session command, measured 2026-11-21) fails open as at HEAD and stays unnamed; it has no Found-and-left line and no filed task.
decisions.why: Rarity and 'as at HEAD' are not grounds, and are not relied on here. The task line's class is paths a program builds from its OWN LITERALS, and this root is not one: its value exists only at run time, from argv, and is not in the program text this reader reads. A reader of program text cannot name a value that text does not hold, so the rule is impossible here rather than merely awkward. Naming it would take a different reader, one that binds the shell's argv into the program, which is a new mechanism outside this task's class. No task carries it today.
